mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNBBS (NTT_ID, BBS_ID, NTT_SJ, NTT_CN, SORT_ORDR, NTCR_ID, NTCR_NM, PASSWORD, RDCNT, NTCE_BGNDE, NTCE_ENDDE, ANSWER_AT, PARNTSCTT_NO, NTT_NO, ANSWER_LC, ATCH_FILE_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, USE_AT, SJ_BOLD_AT, NOTICE_AT, SECRET_AT ) VALUES ( #{nttId}, #{bbsId}, #{nttSj}, #{nttCn}, #{nttId}, #{audit.userId}, (SELECT LEFT(u.user_name, 20) FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{audit.userId}), NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, #{replyAt}, #{parnts}, 1, #{replyLc}, NULL, #{audit.userId}, #{audit.now}, 'Y', 'N', #{noticeAt}, 'N' )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.NTT_ID, a.NTT_SJ, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, IFNULL(u.user_name, a.NTCR_NM) as FRST_REGISTER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') as FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, a.RDCNT, a.PARNTSCTT_NO, a.ANSWER_AT, a.ANSWER_LC, a.USE_AT, a.ATCH_FILE_ID, a.BBS_ID, a.NTCE_BGNDE, a.NTCE_ENDDE, a.SJ_BOLD_AT, a.NOTICE_AT, a.SECRET_AT FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = u.user_id WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND a.USE_AT = 'Y'
ORDER BY a.NOTICE_AT DESC, a.SORT_ORDR DESC, a.NTT_NO ASC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(a.NTT_ID) FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = u.user_id WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND a.USE_AT = 'Y'

SELECT a.NTT_SJ, a.NTCR_ID, a.NTCR_NM, a.NTT_NO, a.NTT_CN, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, IFNULL(u.user_name, a.NTCR_NM) as FRST_REGISTER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, a.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(a.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, a.NTCE_BGNDE, a.NTCE_ENDDE, a.RDCNT, a.USE_AT, a.ATCH_FILE_ID, a.BBS_ID, a.NTT_ID, a.SJ_BOLD_AT, a.NOTICE_AT, a.SECRET_AT, a.PARNTSCTT_NO, a.ANSWER_AT, a.ANSWER_LC, a.SORT_ORDR, c.BBS_TY_CODE, c.REPLY_POSBL_AT, c.FILE_ATCH_POSBL_AT, c.ATCH_POSBL_FILE_NUMBER, c.BBS_NM FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER c ON a.BBS_ID = c.BBS_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND a.NTT_ID = #{nttId} AND a.USE_AT = 'Y'
